# TX2 Unofficial Fansite

> Independent, non-commercial bilingual fan site for the TX2 Pigeonification Ritual campaign and band archive. Version 1.2.0, Last Updated 2026-11-19.

## Technical Overview
- Brand: TX2 Unofficial Fansite
- Version: 1.2.0
- Last Updated: 2026-11-19
- Architecture: Separate static HTML documents for English and Polish (/pl/... and /news/pl/)
- Fonts: Self-hosted Inter WOFF2 fonts (inter-latin.woff2 and inter-latin-ext.woff2)
- UI & Scripts: Pure HTML and CSS UI plus lightweight lightbox.js and tours.js
- Privacy: No cookies and no sessionStorage
- Favicon Attribution: kalashnyk (https://aticon.com/authors/kalashnyk)
- Contact: tx2pigeon@emo-changeling.xyz, admin@toxic-echo.studio
